title: SpecTree TDS composition manifest (version 1)
description: Parsed shape of a SpecTree .tds composition manifest (ADR-0021). The line grammar is the authoring format; this schema is the published contract for the parsed AST. Versioned independently of the vendored Minotaur-Grammars grammars.

solution.description: File name of the bound SolutionManifest under spectree/specs/.

version.description: Semantic version of the composed TDS document.

kind.description: Rendering target: mkdocs (nav anchor section), techdocs (Backstage TechDocs publisher), standalone (export directory).

params.description: Target parameters, e.g. {"nav": "Traceability"} for mkdocs, {"publisher": "docs"} for techdocs, {"path": "docs/generated/tds"} for standalone.

pattern.description: Glob or path relative to the pipeline root (example/).

generated.description: True for pipeline-generated artefacts declared with the (generated) qualifier: never blob-bound in the composition report; their integrity derives from the deterministic build that produces them from blob-bound sources (ADR-0013/0015).
